html: II. כלל (assumed as √ of foll., but dubious; cf. NH כַּלָּה; Aramaic כַּלְּתָא, ܟܰܠܬܳܐ; Arabic كَنَّةٌ; Assyrian kallâtu, expl. by DlProl. 130 f. (cf. Id. HWB 330) as proposes closed bridal chamber (ideogr. = closed chamber), from √ כלא or כלה, thence bride (cf. harem); according to RSK 136 f. 292 כַּלָּה = one closed in, or reserved (sc. for her husband); Ges al. one crowned (cf. Aramaic etc. כלילא crown), but form much against this; NöZMG 1886, 737 ‘ventures no explanation’).
